about: The papers of 2050 Research, in the order of the front page. key = the page's key in hub/build.py PAGES; finding = the paper's answer in one sentence, from its own page; sources = its source trail; n = specks around its star in the paper space (one per source); also = its one other form (a path, or film:<id> for the front page's film player); links = papers that share sources with it; copies = the paper in another language (they wear the paper's look, without the English series at the end). {tweets}, {authors} and {quotes} are filled from tweets/tweets.json and books/quotes.json by hub/research/papers.py.

papers.title: Book Projection 2050
papers.finding: Of eighteen books about 2050, only The Future We Choose describes that year directly: once at 3 °C of warming, once with Paris kept.

papers.title: 2050 in {tweets} Tweets
papers.finding: What futurists wrote on X about 2050, word for word; the sharpest disagreements are AI risk and whether China peaks.

papers.title: Futurists on 2050
papers.finding: Four views recur across twelve futurists: strong AI before 2050, energy off fossil fuels, an older world, climate damage limited only under conditions.

papers.title: 2050 in Futurists’ Tweets
papers.finding: By 2050 expertise and labour are almost free, energy is mostly clean, people are older, and AI agents use most of the internet.

papers.title: Further 2050
papers.finding: Sixteen bold claims for 2030 to 2050, each standing on a seed that has already happened and its most beautiful free picture.

papers.title: Projection 2050
papers.finding: Eighteen films about 2050, chosen for being plausible and beautiful, cut into three blocks of about forty minutes for the wall.

papers.title: Why Music Changes
papers.finding: Music changes when money, power, belief, technology or contact shifts, and the next shift is audible: abundant, generated, global.

papers.title: Viral Webcam Effects
papers.finding: The camera effects going viral on X are hand tracking, not filters: a webcam, MediaPipe’s 21 points per hand and a shader.
